content: Why incorporate -PMI? $\mathit {\texttt {+}PPMI}$ only falters on the RW and analogy tasks, and we hypothesize this is where $\mathit {\texttt {-}PMI}$ is useful: in the absence of positive information, negative information can be used to improve rare word representations and word analogies. Analogies are solved using nearest neighbor lookups in the vector space, and so accounting for negative cooccurrence effectively repels words with which no positive cooccurrence was observed. In future work, we will explore incorporating $\mathit {\texttt {-}PMI}$ only for rare words (where it is most needed).
